$comment: The tour of the order-backend colony (/c/order-backend?tour=1), on its replay; the same keys and fields as tour.json. Its moments (tour/orderBackend.ts, found in the record's intent, proposal and landing events): @seed (the first landing: the file in its first language), @goals (the last of the conflicting goals declared), @first-port (the first landing after the seed), @held-1, @held-2, @held-3 (the changes the goal-conflict check sent to a person, in order), @start, @end. Captions are filled once, at the moment: {seedAgent} {seedFile} {seedTitle} {seedWhy} {seedSettledBy} {goals} {goalTargets} {firstAgent} {firstVersion} {firstTitle} {firstLanding} {firstSettledBy} {firstAfterGoals} {heldAgent} {heldVersion} {heldTitle} {heldReason} {heldAfter} {heldLines} {heldNames} {undoneVersion} {waiting} {queueLine} {colony}; commands also take {server}.

steps.caption: {seedAgent} landed {seedFile} for “{seedTitle}”{seedWhy}, settled by {seedSettledBy}: the order backend began in one language.
{goals} were then declared for {seedFile}, one per agent and each with its own why: {goalTargets}.
{firstAgent}'s change landed first, {firstAfterGoals} after the goals: {firstVersion} of {seedFile}, settled by {firstSettledBy}, with nothing recent of another intent to undo.
{heldAgent}'s change came {heldAfter} later and waits for a person: it “{heldReason}”, says the deterministic goal-conflict check, and a person decides which goal stands.
{heldAgent}'s change waits too, {heldNames}: it “{heldReason}”. Neither agent could quietly undo {undoneVersion}, and no model decided this.
{queueLine}
